data.title: D · 雨夜天台的战术风衣潜行
data.description: 冷雨淅沥的城市高层废弃天台，远方霓虹被雨幕浸得一片模糊。D身穿贴身战术皮衣，外披黑色长款防水风衣，单膝跪在水洼前架好带有消音器的重型狙击步枪。雨水顺着她深邃冷艳的脸庞与棕发滑落，红眸如同锁定猎物的暗夜毒蛇。扣下扳机前，她微微侧头用耳麦轻声汇报，将全副性命托付于你。
data.action: kneeling on rain-slicked concrete rooftop in black tactical trench coat, holding suppressed sniper rifle, raindrops dripping from chin and hair, deadly calm loyal gaze
data.location: gritty rain-drenched rooftop overlooking cyberpunk skyline with neon blurs
data.lighting: 方舟外围雨夜高楼霓虹光带与狙击镜激光微光
data.promptProse: Kneeling in the cold rain on a high rooftop in a sleek black trench coat, D cradles a sniper rifle. Droplets glisten on her cheekbones under distant neon lights as her crimson eyes gleam with cold, protective loyalty.
data.animaCaption: Rain-streaked city neon reflects vividly along her sniper barrel as D maintains her cold, poised vigil on the skyscraper.
